name: Hypergraph Studio
description: Build, visualize, and analyze hypergraphs with interactive graph views, permutations, automorphisms, matrices, and spectral information.

name: Isomorphism & Spectral Analyzer
description: Compare hypergraphs for isomorphism and inspect spectral invariants with interactive analysis.

name: Hypergraph Edge Orbits
description: Generate edge-orbit tables under vertex permutations and explore the orbit graph interactively.

name: Transversal & Hitting-Set Solver
description: Find minimum transversals and enumerate minimal hitting sets, with edge coverage inspection.

name: Hypergraph Coloring Solver
description: Explore weak and strong vertex colorings and search for colorings with fewer colors.

name: Automorphism Group Explorer
description: Explore vertex symmetries, calculate automorphism group order, and identify vertex orbits.

name: Matching & Packing Solver
description: Find maximum or maximal matchings and inspect selected edges, with JSON export.

name: Turing Lab — Machine Simulator
description: Build deterministic Turing machines, edit transition rules, and watch tape execution step by step.

name: Probability, PMF & Entropy Lab
description: Explore probability mass functions, entropy, sums of random variables, and convolution with live charts.
